theorem physical_main_sides {κ ε : ℝ} (hκ : 0<κ) (he : 0<ε) :
    ∃ T : ℕ,4≤T ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,T≤N → Even N → ∀ (Q z s : ℝ) (d : ℕ),
      0<d → d≤N → 1<Q/(d:ℝ) → (N:ℝ)^κ≤z →
      s=log (Q/(d:ℝ))/log z → 2≤s → s≤10 →
      model true N Q d z ≤ (upperA s + ε)*thetaAtom N Q d ∧
      (lowerBar s - ε)*thetaAtom N Q d ≤ model false N Q d z

theorem true_seed_to_mother {N n p : ℕ} {k : Root} {t : ℝ}
    (hN : 2≤N) (ht : 0≤t) (ht' : t≤1/12) (hn : 1/((n:ℝ)+1)≤11/384) (hp : p∈originalBand N k) :
    let S := seedPositions N n k t p
    (∑ l∈S,levelMark l*trueAt l) ≤
      Phi N (rootQ N n k t p) (S.image wordProduct) (groupedSigma S wordProduct levelMark) (11/5)

theorem seed_source_at_signed_AP {ε J : ℝ} (he : 0<ε) (hJ : J<actualJ2omega) :
    ∃ T : ℕ,4≤T ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,T≤N → Even N → ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : Root) (t : ℝ) (p : ℕ),
      0≤t → t≤1/12 → 1/((n:ℝ)+1)≤11/384 → p∈originalBand N k →
      let Q := rootQ N n k t p; let S := seedPositions N n k t p
      let D := S.image wordProduct; let σ := groupedSigma S wordProduct levelMark
      5*((∑ l∈S,levelMark l*trueAt l)-(1-J)*markedTheta S)+credit N Q D σ ≤
        residue N Q D σ+ε*markedTheta S

theorem initial_and_four_rounds_at_signed_AP {ε : ℝ} (he : 0<ε) :
    ∃ T : ℕ,4≤T ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,T≤N → Even N → ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : Root) (t : ℝ) (p : ℕ),
      0≤t → t≤1/12 → 1/((n:ℝ)+1)≤11/384 → p∈originalBand N k →
      let Q := rootQ N n k t p; let S := seedPositions N n k t p
      let D := S.image wordProduct; let σ := groupedSigma S wordProduct levelMark
      let count := ∑ l∈S,levelMark l*trueAt l
      (5*(count-(1-1/50:ℝ)*markedTheta S)+credit N Q D σ ≤ residue N Q D σ+ε*markedTheta S) ∧
      (∀ r : Fin 4,5*(count-(1-originalRound r.succ)*markedTheta S)+credit N Q D σ ≤
        residue N Q D σ+5*originalRound r.castSucc*
          (∑ l∈S,levelMark l*physicalFeedback N Q (wordLevel l) (wordProduct l))+ε*markedTheta S)

theorem true_child_ceil {N n p d q : ℕ} (k : Root) (t : ℝ) (hq : q.Prime)
    (hcop : q.Coprime N) (hd : 0<d) (hQ : 0≤rootQ N n k t p) :
    ⌈childLevel (rootQ N n k t p) d q⌉₊ =
      P2ActualMarkedCountState.rootLevel (rootQ N n k t p) (d*q)

theorem true_child_mean_eq_model {N n p d q : ℕ} (k : Root) (t : ℝ)
    (hd : 0<d) (hcop : d.Coprime N) (hq : q.Prime) (hqN : q.Coprime N)
    (hQ : 0≤rootQ N n k t p) (hlo : cutoff (rootQ N n k t p) d s0≤(q:ℝ)) :
    childMean N (rootQ N n k t p) d q =
      model false N (rootQ N n k t p) (d*q) (cutoff (rootQ N n k t p) d s0)

theorem coordinates (j : Fin 3) : anchor (lane j)=227/50 ∧ top (lane j)=edge j ∧
    a0 (originalW2At 0)=50/227 ∧ singletonTop (originalW2At 0) j=edge j ∧
    edge j=1/stop j ∧ (50/227:ℝ)<edge j ∧ edge j≤5/11

theorem W_eq {N d : ℕ} {Q L : ℝ} (hd : 0<d) (hQ : Q=(d:ℝ)*(N:ℝ)^L) (j : Fin 3) :
    W N Q d j=window N Q L d (lane j)
theorem integral_eq (j : Fin 3) : integral (lane j)=negative (edge j)

theorem ordinary_and_child_mass {ε : ℝ} (he : 0<ε) :
    ∃ T : ℕ,4≤T ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,T≤N → ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : Root) (t : ℝ) (p dep : ℕ),
      0≤t → t≤1/12 → 1/((n:ℝ)+1)≤11/384 → p∈originalBand N k →
      ∀ (l : LevelIndex N n k t p dep) (j : Fin 3),
        let Q := rootQ N n k t p; let d := wordProduct l; let L := wordLevel l
        |ordinaryWindow N Q L d (lane j)-thetaAtom N Q d*negative (edge j)|≤ε*thetaAtom N Q d ∧
        (∑ q∈W N Q d j,thetaAtom N Q (d*q)) ≤ 4*thetaAtom N Q d

theorem quotient_plus_credit (N : ℕ) (Q : ℝ) (D : Finset ℕ) (σ : ℕ → ℝ) :
    weightedQuotient N Q D σ+credit N Q D σ =
      4*Phi N Q D σ (227/50)+Phi N Q D σ (353/100)-negativeMean N Q D σ-
        negativeSignedRemainder N Q D σ+positivePairs N Q D σ+switchedCount N Q D σ

theorem source_count_with_credit {η ε : ℝ} (hη : 0<η) (he : 0<ε) :
    ∃ T : ℕ,4≤T ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,T≤N → Even N → ∀ (Q : ℝ) (D : Finset ℕ) (σ : ℕ → ℝ),
      Q≤(N:ℝ) → (∀ d∈D,0<d) → (∀ d∈D,0≤σ d) → (∀ d∈D,1<Q/(d:ℝ)) →
      (∀ d∈D,∀ q∈d.primeFactors,(N:ℝ)^η≤(q:ℝ)) → (∀ d∈D,(N:ℝ)^η≤cutoff Q d (227/50)) →
      5*Phi N Q D σ (11/5)+credit N Q D σ+negativeMean N Q D σ+piCenteredPhysicalError N Q D σ ≤
        4*Phi N Q D σ (227/50)+Phi N Q D σ (353/100)+positivePairs N Q D σ+
          (∑ d∈D,σ d*actualLocalPrimeMass N Q d)+ε*Theta N Q D σ

theorem window_mean_payment {ε : ℝ} (he : 0<ε) :
    ∃ T : ℕ,4≤T ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,T≤N → Even N → ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : Root) (t : ℝ) (p dep : ℕ),
      0≤t → t≤1/12 → 1/((n:ℝ)+1)≤11/384 → p∈originalBand N k →
      ∀ (l : LevelIndex N n k t p dep) (j : Fin 3),
        let Q := rootQ N n k t p; let d := wordProduct l
        thetaAtom N Q d*negative (edge j) -
          windowMean N Q d (cutoff Q d (stop j)) ≤ ε*thetaAtom N Q d

theorem three_negative_mean_payment {ε : ℝ} (he : 0<ε) :
    ∃ T : ℕ,4≤T ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,T≤N → Even N → ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : Root) (t : ℝ) (p dep : ℕ),
      0≤t → t≤1/12 → 1/((n:ℝ)+1)≤11/384 → p∈originalBand N k →
      ∀ B : Finset (LevelIndex N n k t p dep),
        let Q := rootQ N n k t p; let D := B.image wordProduct; let σ := groupedSigma B wordProduct levelMark
        signedSingles N Q D σ ≤ -(piCenteredPhysicalError N Q D σ)+ε*markedTheta B

theorem scaled_cutoff {N d : ℕ} {η Q s : ℝ} (hN : 1<N) (hη : 0<η)
    (hr : (N:ℝ)^η≤Q/(d:ℝ)) (hs : 1≤s) (hs10 : s≤10) :
    (N:ℝ)^(η/10)≤cutoff Q d s

theorem signed_anchors_to_AP {η ε : ℝ} (hη : 0<η) (he : 0<ε) :
    ∃ T : ℕ,4≤T ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,T≤N → Even N → ∀ (Q : ℝ) (D : Finset ℕ) (σ : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ d∈D,0<d ∧ d≤N ∧ (N:ℝ)^η≤Q/(d:ℝ)) → (∀ d∈D,0≤σ d) →
      signedAnchors N Q D σ≤anchorAP N Q D σ+ε*Theta N Q D σ

theorem seed_anchor_payment {ε : ℝ} (he : 0<ε) :
    ∃ T : ℕ,4≤T ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,T≤N → Even N → ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : Root) (t : ℝ) (p dep : ℕ),
      0≤t → t≤1/12 → 1/((n:ℝ)+1)≤11/384 → p∈originalBand N k →
      ∀ B : Finset (LevelIndex N n k t p dep),
        let Q := rootQ N n k t p; let D := B.image wordProduct; let σ := groupedSigma B wordProduct levelMark
        signedAnchors N Q D σ≤anchorAP N Q D σ+ε*markedTheta B
